item: The ring files are read with the catalogue loader's libyaml safe class
summary: The generated ring file (566 KB) was parsed with the pure-Python yaml.safe_load (0.98 s); the catalogue loader's libyaml safe class (seed_sources._load_safe_yaml) takes 0.11 to 0.14 s and returns an equal object (pinned by tests/test_ring_yaml_loader.py). The ring file is read on a first install and on a reseed only, so the saving is about 0.9 s on those boots; a steady boot does not read it and is unaffected. Same safe loader, no new one. Not covered by the equality test: an operator's local ring file (local_rings_path()), which libyaml parses now too; a second test pins the route (the reader calls the catalogue loader) so the old call fails it. Measured on the keyword lane's machine only; the boot ring-wrap harness is in the keyword-export rollup-bench folder.
